database.description: The database the layout is read from. Only used with layoutId; layoutPath carries its own prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/layout/...).

finalLayout.description: Specifies layout to be updated. If 'true', the final layout is set, otherwise - shared layout.

id.description: The ID of the item to set the layout for. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language of the item to set layout for.

layoutId.description: The ID of the layout to set for the item. Supply this or layoutPath.

layoutPath.description: The path of the layout to set for the item. Supply this or layoutId.

path.description: The path of the item to set the layout for. Supply this or id.
